title: $17 a year for ALL health care. Top 5 lowest health spending
description: Where does a whole year of health care cost less than a pizza? Number one will surprise you. Real World Bank data, counted down from five to one.
source: World Bank, current health expenditure per capita (current US$, 2023), data.worldbank.org/indicator/SH.XPD.CHEX.PC.CD; income via NY.GDP.PCAP.CD

segments.text: One country spends just seventeen dollars per person on health. For a whole year. Can you guess which?
Top five lowest. Number five is Gambia. Twenty-six dollars.
Number four is DR Congo. Twenty-three dollars.
Number three is Somalia. Twenty-two dollars.
Number two was torn apart by war in 2023. Sudan. Twenty-one dollars.
And number one is Madagascar. Seventeen dollars. The average income there is only five hundred fourteen dollars a year.
Now the other extreme. The United States spends almost thirteen and a half thousand dollars per person. Triple what it spent in 2000.
That's seven hundred seventy-two times more than Madagascar.
What does a doctor visit cost where you live? Follow for more money, mapped.
